description: SK Telecom is a Seoul-based South Korean mobile operator whose speech-synthesis team builds the A.X TTS models used in its A. (A-dot), NUGU and AI call-centre services. Through the SK open API developer portal it sells Korean-only A.X TTS models (general, news and dialect voices) on a pay-as-you-go plan priced in KRW; sign-up uses an SK T ID or a Korean business registration.
name: SK Telecom (A.X)
